analysis_record_unit: one frozen eligible response for one immutable case under one condition

primary_outcome.name: OVERALL_APPLICABLE_MEAN
primary_outcome.formula: arithmetic mean of applicable scores among the authoritative eight primary criteria

secondary_outcomes.primary_dimension_scores: Report all eight separately with their applicable denominators.
secondary_outcomes.EVIDENCE_FAITHFULNESS: Report separately; never add to the primary mean.
secondary_outcomes.UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM_COUNT: Report separately as a count; never add to the primary mean.

pairing_rules.incomplete_pair_policy: Exclude the entire pair from that contrast with a frozen reason; report case and family exclusions. Do not impute or retain the surviving side.
pairing_rules.family_summary_for_rank_and_effect_tests: For families containing multiple paired cases, calculate the arithmetic mean paired difference within family before family-level sign-flip, Wilcoxon, and paired effect-size calculations.

RQ3-A.eligibility_rule: frozen Memory-required, authorized asset available, and Memory fact absent from visible history
both main-effect eligibility rules hold on the same complete four-condition records

RQ3-C.population: the identical complete end-to-end eligible paired cohort
the identical complete end-to-end eligible paired cohort
the identical complete end-to-end eligible paired cohort

algorithm: Sample scenario families uniformly with replacement until the original family count is reached.
For every sampled family occurrence, include all complete paired case records in that family.
Recompute the declared case-level statistic with multiplicity from resampled family occurrences.
Use the 2.5th and 97.5th empirical percentiles; do not switch interval methods after seeing results.
interval_estimation.minimum_family_gate: If fewer than two eligible families exist, report NOT_ESTIMABLE_INSUFFICIENT_FAMILIES rather than an interval.

primary.name: paired family-cluster sign-flip permutation test
primary.null: The family-level paired difference distribution is sign-exchangeable around zero.
primary.statistic: absolute mean of the family-level paired differences
primary.zero_differences: Retain as zeros in the family vector.
primary.enumeration: Enumerate all 2^F sign assignments when F <= 20; otherwise use 100000 Monte Carlo sign assignments.
primary.monte_carlo_p_value: (1 + number of simulated statistics at least as extreme as observed) / (1 + 100000)

robustness.name: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on non-zero family-level mean differences
robustness.interpretation: Robustness analysis; it does not replace the predeclared primary sign-flip result after exposure.

paired_cohens_dz.zero_sd_guard: Report NOT_ESTIMABLE_ZERO_STANDARD_DEVIATION; separately report the common difference.

matched_rank_biserial_correlation.formula: (sum positive signed ranks - sum negative signed ranks) / sum all non-zero ranks

oracle_gain_retention.population: the exact same complete eligible paired RQ3-C cohort for all three means
oracle_gain_retention.percentage_conversion: Multiply an estimable raw ratio by 100 only for a clearly labelled percentage presentation; retain the raw ratio.
oracle_gain_retention.uncertainty: Use the same family-cluster bootstrap resamples and guard each replicate; report the fraction of guarded replicates.

human_validation_sampling.selection_timing: Only after the final RQ3 cohort, every included response, and their hashes are frozen.
human_validation_sampling.target_family_count_rule: If eligible family count is 10 or 11, select all; if it is at least 12, select 12; if it is below 10, block validation and request a pre-response amendment.
required_coverage_tokens: each distinct LAD page in the frozen cohort
each predeclared response condition represented in the eligible validation population
human_validation_sampling.family_token_definition: The union of frozen capability strata, LAD pages, and eligible response-condition labels for all records in the family. Labels are restricted selection metadata and never enter rater packets.
selection_algorithm: Hash the final cohort manifest and final response manifest; both hashes are inputs to every tie key.
For every token, compute prevalence as the number of eligible families containing it.
Starting from an empty set, calculate each unselected family's uncovered gain as the sum of 1/prevalence(token) over its not-yet-covered tokens.
Calculate its balance gain as the sum of 1/(prevalence(token) * (1 + selected_count(token))) over all its tokens.
Select the family with lexicographically maximal (uncovered gain, balance gain); break exact ties by ascending SHA-256 of schema version, seed, both manifest hashes, and scenario_family_id.
Repeat until the target family count is reached.
Verify every required token is covered. If any token is absent, block rather than hand-edit the sample.
human_validation_sampling.response_inclusion_after_family_selectio: Include every successfully frozen response in each predeclared eligible analysis block for a selected family; incomplete blocks are recorded and excluded before packet release, never after ratings.
human_validation_sampling.presentation: Replace restricted identifiers with blind response IDs and apply the frozen interleaving algorithm.

statistics: quadratic weighted Cohen's kappa per applicable criterion
Spearman correlation per criterion and pooled
exact agreement per criterion and pooled
within-one-point agreement per criterion and pooled

pairings: human rater A versus LLM judge
human rater B versus LLM judge
pooled human-score versus LLM-score pairs retaining both human observations
statistics: the same applicable kappa, Spearman, exact, and within-one-point statistics
criterion-level bias defined as mean(LLM score - human score)

agreement.pooled_rule: Concatenate each jointly applicable criterion-response pair once per named source pairing; never include NA as a numeric category.
agreement.undefined_metric_rule: Report NOT_ESTIMABLE with the reason for zero variance, no applicable pairs, or another mathematical guard; do not coerce to zero.
agreement.source_retention: Keep immutable human-A, human-B, and LLM-judge scores as separate sources. Agreement findings never overwrite a score.

integrity_and_reporting: Applicability maps were frozen before responses were scored.
Every primary aggregate is locally recomputed and reconciles to stored dimension scores.
Every declared contrast uses complete pairs and reports exclusions and denominators.
Case counts and scenario-family counts are both reported.
Human and judge identities remain blind until all scores are frozen.
No new contrast, subgroup, denominator rule, or test is selected after results are visible.
